evidence: Built provenance_walker.py, which walks every workstreams/po03/attempts/<task_id>/ slot in the working tree or at an immutable commit and roots each result by measuring the SHA-256 of control/tasks/<task_id>/input.json and acceptance.json rather than restating the result's claims. Ran python3 -I -m unittest discover over the unit subtree: 23 tests, OK, exit 0, captured in evidence/test-run.txt. Real walk captured in evidence/walk-live.txt: at commit 9ba22ff252797c54fcf06475617367f614fe6c08 the walker roots po03-wa-b2e7-025-manifest-generator-verifier with measured input hash ad71ccbd4d660c0f17f0a4abc785953f16e59b28c9b76bb075b5cf51d5968e91 and measured acceptance hash cb35f44be1607bd5dd19b59fe19db9b03b5d81451bd666519fb052e48ed25fd8, printing PO03_PROVENANCE_PASS and exiting 0; the same walk without --task-id exits 1 because this unit's own slot was then artifact-bearing with no result.json, reported as ORPHAN_SLOT. A test measured all 65 frozen capsules in the repository and found every capsule's declared source_hashes.acceptance_contract_sha256 equal to the SHA-256 of its own acceptance.json bytes.
falsifiable_hypothesis: Every counted result traces back to its immutable task input and acceptance contract by hash.
limitations: emit_result.py copies acceptance_contract_sha256 out of the capsule instead of hashing acceptance.json, so a result's acceptance claim is unverified at emission time; the walker measures it, which is the reason CAPSULE_SELF_INCONSISTENT exists. Measured today all 65 capsules are consistent, so this is a latent gap and not a live defect.

Rooting is relative to capsule bytes present at walk time: a capsule and every citing result rewritten together would still report ROOTED. The available external anchors are the capsule controller_head_sha and the hash-chained events under control/events/<task_id>/, of which this walker only checks that the chain is non-empty.
The walker cannot distinguish a legitimately in-flight slot from an abandoned one; both surface as ORPHAN_SLOT, which is why a whole-repository walk exits 1 while a producer is mid-unit.
